mapper.select: SELECT INSTANCE_ID, REPLY, DEGRADED, UPDATED_AT FROM WF_REPLY WHERE 1=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_REPLY (INSTANCE_ID, REPLY, DEGRADED, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{reply}, #{degraded}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE REPLY = VALUES(REPLY), DEGRADED = VALUES(DEGRADED), UPDATED_AT = VALUES(UPDATED_AT)
mapper.select: SELECT REPLY FROM WF_REPLY WHERE INSTANCE_ID = #{instanceId}
